At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects rural health care service providers, networks, and underserved populations in local communities or regions.
dimensions.evidence: meet the health care needs of rural underserved populations in the local community or region to be served

dimensions.assessment: Moderate impact on the continuity and operational focus of federal rural health grants and local healthcare delivery.
dimensions.evidence: This bill reauthorizes through FY2030 grant programs... that provide funding to health care service providers and related entities in rural areas.

dimensions.assessment: Extends existing grant authorizations through FY2030, though exact funding levels are not specified in the text.
Amends the Public Health Service Act to extend grant programs and add mandatory planning and service conditions for grant recipients.
dimensions.evidence: Section 330A(j) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 254c(j)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends authorization for a 5-year period from fiscal year 2026 through fiscal year 2030.

missing_information: Dollar amounts authorized for appropriation for the reauthorized fiscal years
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes HRSA rural health grant programs through fiscal year 2030 and adds requirements that grant funds directly target and involve rural underserved populations. This affects grant-funded healthcare providers and rural communities across the nation.
